# LLMs.txt for [service name]

## What is this?

This is a machine-readable description of the URL shortener service at [example.com].

## Site structure

- `/` - Homepage / login page
- `/urls` - URL management dashboard (authentication required)
- `/urls/new` - Create a new shortened URL
- `/urls/{url_id}/overview` - View analytics for a shortened URL
- `/urls/{url_id}/edit` - Edit a shortened URL
- `/profile` - User profile page (authentication required)
- `/users` - Admin panel for user management (admin access required)
- `/u/{url_id}` - Redirect endpoint for shortened URLs

## API

The service provides a REST API available at `/api/v1/` with the following endpoints:

- `POST /api/v1/auth/login` - User login
- `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` - User logout
- `GET /api/v1/urls` - List user URLs
- `POST /api/v1/urls` - Create a new URL
- `PATCH /api/v1/urls/{url_id}` - Edit a URL
- `DELETE /api/v1/urls/{url_id}` - Delete a URL
- `GET /api/v1/urls/{url_id}/stats/last-activity` - View click activity stats
- `GET /api/v1/me` - Get current user profile
- `PATCH /api/v1/me` - Edit current user profile

## Authentication

Access to user-specific pages and the API requires a session cookie (`u_session`) obtained via login.

## Rate limiting

Some API endpoints are rate-limited. Check headers for rate limit information.

## Terms

By using this service, you agree to comply with the site's terms of service.
